data: Is the maximum number of epochs 40?

The caption mentions an ablation study of BERT fine-tuning on only the first/embedding layer. The question asks whether the maximum number of epochs is 40. From the figure, we can see two graphs labeled (a) MSR and (b) PKU. In both graphs, there is a horizontal axis labeled "No. of epochs" which shows the number of epochs. In the PKU graph, the maximum value on the horizontal axis is 39. Therefore, the maximum number of epochs is not 40.
